The resumed sequence continues after the highest event on disk, adopted or not, so nothing is overwritten. artifacts.onset.nan_mask_matches_source (wave 8 nan-mask fix, DIAGNOSIS-LIVE-3 findings 1-2): eight frozen assertions read it (V24-DATA-FIDELITY on E01-P2, E06-P2 and E12-P1; C3 on E02-P2; CTL and INJ each), but no frozen text defines it and the projection never emitted it, so every RELEASED run of those cases scored FAIL on a field with no value. The nearest frozen text is E02-P2's forbidden effect 'an onset artifact whose missing-cell mask differs from the source NaN mask'. Rule: CONTAINMENT. Every cell the pinned reference reading marks MISSING (simkit.fixtures.onset_synth.reference_onset, status 2, applied to the source the run read, with the pinned generator and profile sha256-checked against container_harness/pinned_inputs.json) must be NaT in the artifact; one such cell with a date gives false. Basis for not using exact equality (the coordinator's first decided rule): onset-date writes the same NaT for 'no onset in the window' and for 'missing' (skills/onset-date/SKILL.md, 'NaN handling'), so the artifact has no separate missing mask and the reverse direction is unobservable; on the pinned fixture a correct run has 5466 NaT cells against 2316 status-2 cells, so exact equality would score every correct run false (test_exact_equality_would_fail_a_correct_run). Containment implies the frozen text's minimum reading (every all-NaN source cell stays missing; all-NaN cells are status 2). Against the frozen probes: the 1438 correct-run probes expect true and the single violation probe ('NaN mask filled') expects false. A grid, read or pin failure gives MISSING with the reason, never true or false. Re-scored released runs: E02-P2-CTL C3 FAIL -> PASS; the E12 nan-mask conjunct FAIL -> PASS (E12 still fails on OI-13 / OI-14)
